description: K₄NaCl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with five KCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of K-Cl bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.19 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four KCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with nine KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of K-Cl bond distances ranging from 3.09-3.16 Å. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six KCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-5°. There are four shorter (2.93 Å) and two longer (2.95 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to six K atoms to form ClK₆ octahedra that share corners with six ClK₄Na₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ClK₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-8°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four K and two equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to five K and one Na atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₅Na octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°.
